name: MuseScore Studio
summary: AI-assisted code, docs, issues and other contributions are allowed. You must review and understand everything, disclose substantial AI output (Assisted-by trailer for commits) and check licensing. Writing PR descriptions yourself is strongly recommended, and maintainer feedback must not be pasted into AI.

evidence.quote: You may use LLMs and AI coding tools to help write code, tests, documentation, translations, and other contributions to MuseScore Studio.
Contributors must read, review, and understand all LLM-generated code and text, including code comments, before requesting review.
Disclose AI assistance when an AI tool produced a substantial portion of the submitted content.
If generated output appears to reproduce code, text, artwork, or other material from an identifiable source, you must verify that you have the right to use it
For issues or other contributions that do not involve commits, disclose the assistance in the relevant issue, template field, or accompanying description.
it is strongly recommended that contributors write PR descriptions themselves (if needed, using tools for translation or copy-editing).
Do not mechanically paste maintainer feedback into an AI tool and submit its response.

sources.title: AI / LLM Usage Policy for Contributors
